name: FA_DEPRN_TAX_AUTHORITIES_
description: FA_DEPRN_TAX_AUTHORITIES stores tax-authority-level information required by Japanese Depreciable Assets Tax Reports.

columns.name: CODE
columns.description: Tax authority identification code.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Tax authority name used in the asset tax report.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Asset book type identification code.

columns.name: OWNER_CODE
columns.description: Tax code identifier for the company.

columns.name: SHORT_YEAR_DEPRN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a short year depreciation is used.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_INC_DEPRN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to send a notification for increased depreciation.

columns.name: NON_TAXABLE_ASSETS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether nontaxable assets are included.

columns.name: TAX_STANDARD_EXCEPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a standard tax exception is allowed.

columns.name: SPECIAL_DEPRN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether special depreciation is used.

columns.name: DEPRN_METHOD_UNDER_TAX_LAW
columns.description: Tax accounting depreciation method code.

columns.name: BLUE_RETURN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the blue return is used.

columns.name: LOCATION_OWNERSHIP_CODE
